answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 61605 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Meaning of name Rushda and Nuwaira Question: I would like to name my daughter as Nuwaira Zainab or Rushda Zainab expecting in second week of September 2015. Could you please verify and suggest which name is better Nuwaira or Rushda. Answer ID: 61605 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 88/80/H=01/1437) You can keep her name as Rushda Zainab. It shall be good, in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
